a.xlink:title: Tells the user an update is running without blocking, honoring a hidden status bar.
Emitted after the card-database update subprocess exits.
Tries to bring the open card database updater window to the front.
Shows the widget and resets it to the indeterminate state.
Loads card databases from configured paths, using the binary cache when valid.
Posts a tray notification when the status bar cannot show progress.
Emitted while the card-database update subprocess runs. progress.done/progress.total are byte counts ...
Parses one line of the updater stdout protocol: "PROGRESS <stage> <done> <total>".
Builds a QLocalServer/QLocalSocket name scoped to the current user.
